reason: The README clearly describes a DeepSeek Harness plugin for decomposing work into parallel subagent tasks, scheduling their execution, aggregating results, and displaying progress in chat.

summaries.zh: 用于在 DeepSeek Harness 中拆分任务并并行调度多个子 Agent，汇总结果并在聊天界面显示执行进度。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that decomposes tasks for parallel subagent execution, aggregates results, and displays live progress in chat.

capabilities: registers a swarm_batch tool for dispatching up to 128 subagent tasks
starts and schedules multiple subagents concurrently
supports task cancellation, timeouts, retries, and resuming completed agent work
assigns models by task or batch configuration
publishes subagent progress events and renders status in the chat interface
